facts.statement: Jintasaurus is a genus of hadrosauriform dinosaur known as the "Jinta County dragon".
facts.quote: Jintasaurus (; meaning "Jinta County dragon") is a genus of hadrosauriform dinosaur

facts.statement: The type species Jintasaurus meniscus was described by Hai-Lu You and Da-Qing Li in 2009.
facts.quote: The type species is J. meniscus, described by Hai-Lu You and Da-Qing Li in 2009

facts.statement: The only known specimen of Jintasaurus is a partial postorbital skull that lacks the jugal and quadratojugal bones.
facts.quote: The holotype and only known specimen includes the postorbital skull, lacking the jugal and quadratojugal

facts.statement: Jintasaurus lived during the Early Cretaceous in what is now Jiuquan, Gansu, in northwestern China.
facts.quote: lived during the Early Cretaceous of what is now Jiuquan, Gansu, northwestern China

facts.statement: Jintasaurus is classified within the infraorder Iguanodontia.
Jintasaurus lived during the middle of the Cretaceous period, approximately 105 million years ago in the Albian stage.
facts.quote: vivió a mediados del período Cretácico, hace aproximadamente 105 millones de años, en el Albiense

facts.statement: Jintasaurus was likely a relatively robust, semi-bipedal herbivore about six meters long.
facts.quote: Posiblemente el Jintasaurus era un herbívoro semibípedo relativamente robusto con una longitud de unos seis metros

facts.statement: The skull of Jintasaurus is characterized by an extremely long paraoccipital process projecting over the lower part of the occipital condyle.
facts.quote: El cráneo se caracteriza por una forma paraoccipital extremadamente larga que se proyecta sobre la parte inferior del condilo occipital

facts.statement: The time range for Jintasaurus is estimated from 121.4 to 113.2 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Aptian to Aptian (121.4 to 113.2 million years ago)

rejected.statement: Jintasaurus is considered more evolved than other Early Cretaceous hadrosaurs and some Late Cretaceous ones like Protohadros.
rejected.quote: El Jintasaurus en especial se considera más evolucionado que otros hadrosaurios del Cretáceo inferior y algunos del Cretáceo superior, como el Protohadros

rejected.quote: whose discovery supports the theory that hadrosaurs originated in Asia
